scope: Read-only source/contract review. No edits to inspected repositories, tests, proof reruns, cap changes or dispatch. Parent supplied the remote Capture(Cancelled) outcome; this review does not independently reproduce it.
conclusion: 7200 seconds is an explicitly selected physical host allowance AND the currently enforced compacting Joy API ceiling. It is not an SH8 semantic clock assertion or an explicit two-hour user SLA. A separately reviewed Linux profile can prove the same SH8 relation, but cannot exceed two hours with the unchanged pinned Joy API or unchanged CI profile.

normative_map.claim: SH8 exact-relation acceptance and measured performance
normative_map.detail: Both full self-builds, exact compiler/source/options/output/machine/profile/cost binding, fresh independent verification, mutation rejection, equal C2/C3 and regression corpus; elapsed time is recorded, with no maximum in SH8.

normative_map.claim: Predetermined bounds and explicit contract changes
normative_map.detail: SH6 currently fixes 7200000ms as a host allowance. Numeric bounds are set before acceptance; changing a bound requires contract and boundary-test updates. An exhausted original repetition remains failed; no in-run increase.

normative_map.claim: Physical clock is separate from the logical claim
normative_map.detail: JOB1 LIM1 has no time_ms. Context binds program/formula/object full particles, profile, budget and logical frame allowance. Physical allocation, resident storage, GC, elapsed time and RSS remain independently checked host observations, not proved quantities.

normative_map.claim: Current API rejects more than two hours
normative_map.detail: Explicit compacting time ceiling is 7200000ms; test admits exact ceiling and rejects 7200001. Ordinary execution maximum is 300000ms and default time_ms is 30000ms.
All public routes validate the same RunLimits; ordinary versus explicit compaction is the existing distinction.

normative_map.claim: Frozen local and Linux profile checks cannot silently admit a new timer
normative_map.detail: The archive validator requires exact original host flags and proof caps. Preserve that historical profile unchanged; a new reviewed host-clock selection must be explicit and separately identified.

normative_map.claim: Whole-run outer deadlines also need coherent review
normative_map.detail: Current process outer deadline is 7500 seconds. The replay step is 300min, retention 45min and final metadata 10min within a 360min job.

recommendation.change: Smallest coherent production change: raise only COMPACT_TIME_MS to 14400000 and document the explicit compacting host ceiling. Preserve default 30000, ordinary maximum 300000, all work/storage/proof caps, context encoding and JOB1 schema.
recommendation.tests: Retain old exact 7200000 acceptance; add 14400000 acceptance, 14400001 and zero rejection, output/cost equivalence, failed-publication preservation and applicable prove/verify admission/cancellation checks. No actual multi-hour test is needed to test admission boundaries.
recommendation.separate_jobs: A 240min cooperative producer and 120min fresh verifier in separate native Linux jobs need no semantic-context change. Producer outer/process/step bounds must exceed its internal deadline enough to join, persist failures and retain evidence. Build, input/proof transfer and retention must fit each 360min job; 240min step exactly matching its cooperative deadline is insufficient. A four-hour bound does not establish that this workload will finish within it.
recommendation.identity: Commit and pin the new Joy source and distinct Linux host profile. Preserve both complete compiler inputs, 94-module JOB1/source package, accepted particles/cost/frames/steps/RES1/ART1 and current proof caps. Retain original failed Linux attempts unchanged; label future results separately. Fresh consumer must authenticate the exact producer certificate identity and inputs, then all SH8 adversarial/regression conditions remain required.
